title: Early lessons near the Humphrey family
summary: Took lessons twice a week after school from the old man Humphrey, near Liberty and Cadiz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I don't know. I just fooled around with them a little bit, but I can play them. Let's see. You knew old man Jim Humphreys, you said, huh?

The old man. Yeah, the old man. The Willie Graham. The old man. Yeah. The old man. Yeah. They lived on Clow or Willow Street, between Janet and Cadiz. They used to go there and take my lessons. I was going to school then, but I was going to take my lessons. Where I went. Up around Cadiz and Liberty I think. Oh yeah. Yeah.
It was on Liberty between Janet and Cadiz. I used to go there twice a week out of school. Take my lessons.
